title: Keld Signal Client
description: The keld-signal client: the keld CLI, the keld-agent on-device enrichment daemon, and its GLiNER2/embedding sidecar. On-device privacy-preserving classification, masking, block cutting and project attribution.

title: Keld Atlas Platform
description: The Keld Atlas server: OTLP telemetry ingest, enrichment storage, the admin console and the web app that renders blocks, dynamics and cost attribution for an org.

title: Keld SDKs & CLI Tooling
description: Client SDKs and CLI helpers that wrap Keld's telemetry and enrichment APIs for other languages and tools — keld-cli, keld-python and the OTLP telemetry bindings.

title: Attribution Benchmark
description: The offline benchmark that measured project-attribution quality (embeddings + metadata boost + local LLM verifier) before it was ported into keld-signal's on-device pipeline.
